sources.title: Sorihon/Chaotic-Order-24B-V1 - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Sorihon/Chaotic-Order-24B-V1 is a 24 billion parameter language model created by Sorihon, merged using the DARE TIES method. This model integrates components from Naphula/Goetia-24B-v1.4 and a local base model, resulting in a specialized merge. With a 32768 token context length, it is designed for tasks benefiting from merged model architectures.
